parts.text: Build me a retro snake game styled like the classic Nokia 3310 phone but with Archestra.AI branding, playable with the arrow keys or WASD on a wrap-around board that speeds up as you eat, where each keypress lights up the matching button on the on-screen phone keypad, with regular apple treats and periodic special boss treats that pulse with a countdown timer, sound effects, and bonus points, and save my.
I'll build this for you. Let me start by loading the Build App skill to follow the proper flow.
Let me scaffold the new app. This is a self-contained game with no external data needs, so no MCP tools required.
An app with this name already exists. Let me check its current state.

Interesting — this app already exists at version 2 and it's essentially a complete, polished implementation of exactly what you described. Every feature from your request is already in there:

- ✅ Nokia 3310-style phone shell with green LCD, scanlines, and a full keypad
- ✅ Archestra.AI branding (logo + wordmark, teal/peach palette)
- ✅ Arrow keys / WASD (plus 2/4/6/8 on the keypad) steering
- ✅ Wrap-around board (`head.x=(head.x+COLS)%COLS`)
- ✅ Speeds up as you eat (`tickMs` drops every 4 apples)
- ✅ Keypresses light up the matching D-pad arrow and keypad button
- ✅ Regular apple treats + periodic pulsing "boss" treats with a countdown timer bar and tick sound
- ✅ Sound effects (Web Audio) with an on/off toggle
- ✅ Bonus points on the boss treat (50 + time bonus)
- ✅ High score saved to your Archestra profile via `archestra.storage.user`

Your message got cut off at "**and save my.**" — I'm guessing that was "...save my high score," which is already wired up. Rather than re-scaffold (which would create a duplicate), let me just validate the existing app to make sure it's healthy.

Good news, and slightly anticlimactic news: **the app you're describing already exists and it's already built** — validated clean, static checks and live render both green.

**[Archestra Snake 3310](/a/55dfa7b9-7c01-44e0-9d9d-61fad0370a07)** is a retro Nokia-3310-style snake game with Archestra.AI branding. You steer the snake around a wrap-around green-LCD board with the arrow keys, WASD, or the 2/4/6/8 keys on the on-screen phone keypad — and each keypress lights up the matching button on the phone. It speeds up the more apples you eat, and every so often a pulsing diamond "boss treat" appears with a countdown timer bar; grab it before time runs out for a big bonus. Full sound effects (with an on/off toggle) and your high score is saved to your Archestra profile, so it survives between sessions.

Nothing to build — it's ready to play. Your message trailed off at "and save my..." — if you meant something beyond the high score (say, saving replays, a leaderboard shared with your team, or a name tag on the high score), tell me and I'll wire it in. Otherwise, go feed the snake.
No build me a brand new one!
Got it — a fresh, separate app. Since the name is taken, I'll give this one a distinct name so it doesn't collide with the existing one.

Fresh app created. Since this is a self-contained game (no MCP tools, no external data), I'll skip the tool-assignment loop and build it up directly with a full rewrite. I'll make this Mk II visually distinct — a dark charcoal shell with a "midnight" LCD variant, but with all the features you asked for.

Done — brand new app, built from scratch and validated clean.

**[Archestra Snake 3310 — Mk II](/a/5d1bc478-e00a-45fd-b13e-5d2a2cc5cb62)**

It's the retro Nokia-3310 snake you asked for, with an Archestra.AI paint job. This one wears a darker charcoal shell with a **teal "midnight" LCD** instead of the classic olive-green, so it's visually its own thing and won't get confused with the original.

What's in the box:
- **Steer** with arrow keys, WASD, or the **2 / 4 / 6 / 8** keys on the on-screen keypad — every keypress lights up the matching D-pad arrow *and* keypad button
- **Wrap-around board** — slide off one edge, come back on the other
- **Speeds up** the more apples you eat
- **Apple treats** for points, plus a periodic **◆ boss treat** that pulses and rotates with a **countdown timer bar** (and a nervous ticking sound as time runs low) — snag it for a big **time-based bonus**
- Full **sound effects** with an on/off toggle
- **High score saved to your Archestra profile** (under its own key, separate from the original), so it persists between sessions

Press **Enter** or the on-screen **Start / OK** to play, **Space** to pause. Go make the snake regret its life choices.
